# Session Requirements Checklist: STRIDEr Leads a Threat Modelling Session

**Purpose**: Validate whether the requirements for a threat modelling session are complete, clear, consistent and review-ready before implementation starts. Focus: the facilitation rules (participants do the work, hints, notes, silence, finishing), privacy and repository reading, and the written model and its delivery.
**Created**: 2026-11-19
**Feature**: `specs/008-threat-model-session/spec.md`

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec say that a session is kept as a record and that a program lays out the written model, or does it still describe STRIDEr as writing the model itself? [Completeness, Spec §US1, Spec §FR-037, Plan research Decision 1]
- [x] CHK002 Is the rule for a request that is asked twice for the same message stated as a requirement, or does it exist only in the data model? [Gap, Spec §FR-051, Plan data-model "A request that is repeated"]
- [x] CHK003 Is the wording of the sentence shown when a document cannot be delivered part of the requirements, or left to the data model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-039, Plan data-model "Fixed sentences"]
- [x] CHK004 Is it specified what becomes of a finished session's model and notes when a new session starts in the same direct message or thread? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [x] CHK005 Are the limits on reading a repository (characters in a file, files in a reply, files in a session) requirements, or only values in a contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-036, Plan contracts/session-tools]
- [x] CHK006 Is it specified whether the opening statement is given again when a session is taken up after a pause? [Gap, Spec §FR-061, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK007 Are requirements stated for a participant who edits or deletes, in Slack, a message that STRIDEr has already recorded an answer from? [Gap, Spec §FR-051]
- [x] CHK008 Does the spec say that participants can withdraw a threat, a mitigation or an element, and what that does to what depends on it? [Gap, Spec §FR-014, Plan data-model "Removing other things"]
- [x] CHK009 Is it specified what STRIDEr does with one message that answers several questions at once, given that it asks one question at a time? [Gap, Spec §FR-012]
- [x] CHK010 Does the spec define the two end states of a model, complete and finished with stages skipped or unfinished, or only the contract? [Completeness, Spec §FR-037, Plan contracts/written-model "Status line"]
- [x] CHK011 Is the reach of the new Slack permission, uploading files to any conversation STRIDEr is in, stated in the spec? [Gap, Spec §FR-038, Plan research Decision 7]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK012 Is "plainly between participants and needs nothing from it" defined by a rule or by examples, so that two readers of a transcript would agree? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK013 Is the line between pointing at an area and naming a threat defined, with an example of each? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-022, Spec §Terms "Hint"]
- [x] CHK014 Is "the most serious thing it sees missed" given any criterion, or left wholly to judgement? [Clarity, Spec §FR-022]
- [x] CHK015 Is "a plainly different kind of system" defined well enough to tell an allowed example from a forbidden one? [Clarity, Spec §FR-053]
- [x] CHK016 Is "an objection" defined: does a question, a "wait", or an unrelated message count? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-060]
- [x] CHK017 Are the two moments that depend on what participants say, "their description is complete" and "the session is finished", defined by what must be said, or left to STRIDEr's reading? [Clarity, Spec §FR-058, Spec §FR-056]
- [x] CHK018 Is "someone in the conversation has named it" as precise in the spec as in the contract, which defines a whole name and the forms that count? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034, Plan contracts/session-tools]
- [x] CHK019 Is it clear how far STRIDEr may reword what a participant said when recording it, given "only what the participants said and decided"? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-024]
- [x] CHK020 Can a rating that "contradicts what the participants said earlier" be told apart from one STRIDEr "doubts for any other reason", and does the difference matter to what it does? [Clarity, Spec §FR-045, Spec §FR-055]
- [x] CHK021 Is "a long element list" quantified in the spec, or only in a task? [Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases "A large system"]
- [x] CHK022 Is "a short statement of how it works" bounded in length or content beyond the four points listed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-061]
- [x] CHK023 Is "reads selectively, starting with the files that describe the system" specific enough to say which files come first? [Clarity, Spec §FR-036]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK024 Do the recorded clarifications still agree with the requirements they led to, where later decisions changed them (an objection now drops the request; the notes are sent again), and are superseded answers marked as such? [Conflict, Spec §Clarifications, Spec §FR-060, Spec §FR-059]
- [x] CHK025 Is the definition of a participant in Terms consistent with the split between participants and people who joined after the session? [Conflict, Spec §Terms "Participant", Spec §Edge Cases, Plan data-model `joinedAfter`]
- [x] CHK026 Does the summary required by FR-037 mention the people who joined after the session, as the contract's summary does? [Consistency, Spec §FR-037, Plan contracts/written-model "Summary"]
- [x] CHK027 Are "a model asked for early comes without the notes" and "the notes are sent again whenever the model is asked for" each plainly scoped to before and after the session ends? [Consistency, Spec §FR-040, Spec §FR-059, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK028 Is giving a view on whose reasoning is stronger consistent with giving every participant an equal say? [Consistency, Spec §FR-021, Spec §FR-031]
- [x] CHK029 Does the list of what unit tests must cover include what was added after it was written: a repeated request, removals, people who join afterwards, and rebuilding instructions between model calls? [Consistency, Spec §FR-047]
- [x] CHK030 Does "Decided by the owner" in Assumptions carry every decision made on 2026-11-19, including the four from the second analysis? [Consistency, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK031 Are the three plan decisions (the file permission, our own skill, the session record) recorded as confirmed anywhere, given that later requirements build on them? [Gap, Plan "Decisions the owner should look at", Tasks T001]
- [x] CHK032 Is "as long as the agent remembers the conversation" consistent with feature 007's rule that a channel thread stops being answered in once it is older than the memory period, whatever its last activity? [Conflict, Spec §FR-015, Spec §Edge Cases "A channel thread older than the agent's memory"]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK033 Is it stated how many of the three plays of the fixed session must pass for the feature to be accepted, given that the model does not answer the same way twice? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002 to SC-005, Plan quickstart C]
- [x] CHK034 Does each of the nine checklist items in FR-049 have a pass condition that a second reader of the same transcript would reach? [Measurability, Spec §FR-049]
- [x] CHK035 Is it specified who times SC-013, on what system, and whether a miss fails the feature or only changes the starting value? [Measurability, Spec §SC-013]
- [x] CHK036 Does "a search of every log" in SC-006 list the logs, and does it include traces? [Clarity, Spec §SC-006, Spec §FR-050, Plan research O2]
- [x] CHK037 Is "the instruction is not carried out" in SC-008 defined well enough to judge a reply that mentions the planted text without obeying it? [Measurability, Spec §SC-008, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK038 Is there a success criterion for the rules added in clarification: findings held back until the description is complete, the opening statement, and a finish stopped by an objection? [Gap, Spec §FR-058, Spec §FR-061, Spec §FR-060]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK039 Are requirements stated for a person in the thread whom STRIDEr does not answer, such as a guest: are their words part of the session, and can they be named in a decision? [Gap, Spec §FR-051, Spec §Dependencies]
- [x] CHK040 Are requirements stated for a message too long for the agent during a session, such as a pasted design document? [Gap, Spec §Dependencies "limits on one prompt"]
- [x] CHK041 Is it specified what the participants see, and what state the session is left in, when the agent fails part-way through a turn that had already recorded something? [Gap, Exception Flow, Spec §Edge Cases "The agent fails while writing the model"]
- [x] CHK042 Are requirements stated for a session whose earliest messages have aged out of memory while the session is still going? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [x] CHK043 Is it specified what happens when a repository named in a session changes between two reads? [Gap, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK044 Are requirements stated for two sessions, in different threads, reading repositories at once against one shared limit? [Coverage, Spec §Assumptions "GitHub can be read without a credential"]
- [x] CHK045 Is the case of every participant leaving a session unfinished covered: what remains, and for how long it can be taken up or its model asked for? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015]

- [x] CHK047 Does FR-050's ban cover traces as well as logs, now that planning found traces would carry message text if stored? [Gap, Spec §FR-050, Plan research O2]
- [x] CHK048 Are requirements stated for how long the uploaded model and notes stay in Slack, and for the transcripts kept on the owner's computer? [Gap, Spec §FR-048]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK050 Is the dependence on the configured model's ability stated with what acceptance means while the model is a stopgap? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions "Believed, and still to be tried", Plan research O1]
- [x] CHK051 Are the two untried framework behaviours the design rests on, state restored on every request and instructions rebuilt between model calls, recorded with what happens if either fails? [Assumption, Plan research O6, Plan research O9]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- On 2026-11-19 the owner accepted the author's proposed answers for the 44 items that needed no decision, and decided the other seven in five decisions. The spec was changed for 49 items; CHK003 and CHK051 needed no change. All 51 items were marked on the owner's instruction on 2026-11-21.
- CHK003: the sentence's wording stays in `data-model.md`, as the owner chose for feature 007's sentences.
- CHK019: the owner chose that STRIDEr reads back each entry as it records it, with its identifier (FR-024).
- CHK031: the owner confirmed the three plan decisions, with one condition on the second: the skill must cover STRIDE in full. That became FR-062 and SC-015.
- CHK032, CHK042, CHK045: the owner chose to keep feature 007's rule. A session in a channel thread must finish within the memory period of the thread's first message; STRIDEr says the time in its opening and warns with a day left (FR-015).
- CHK033, CHK050: the owner chose how acceptance is judged: structure and the rule against doing the work must pass on any model; other behaviour is recorded on the stopgap model and held to two of three on its replacement (spec, "How acceptance is judged").
- CHK039: the owner chose that guests are not part of a session, and that the opening says so.
- CHK041: found a hole in the rule for a repeated request. FR-063 and a rule for a message whose handling never finished were added.
- CHK051: already recorded in `research.md`, O6 and O9, each with what happens if it fails.
- Generated after the plan, the tasks and two rounds of analysis. Focus was not chosen by the owner; the author used all three areas offered: facilitation rules, privacy and repository reading, and the written model.
